title: Signora Dorabella, Signora Fiordiligi
subtitle: Despina, Dorabella and Fiordiligi: recitative from Così fan tutte, Act 1

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 1 scene 9, recitative after No. 11
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score (Guglielmo, where the libretto has Guilelmo; buon' ora, ven' hanno, un' altro, più tosto, perchè; Sicuro, è quel ch'è meglio, where the libretto has E, quel ch'è meglio; Fiordiligi's Divertirvi?, where the libretto has Divertirci?).

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 80–83, the recitative between No. 11 and No. 12 (55 bars)
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean; one doubt left open, whether perir. in bar 15 is printed with a colon). Where the print gives a second rhythm for the German words (bars 9, 10, 18, 29, 31, 38, 44, 48, 49 and 53), the Italian rhythm is kept. The German singing translation is left out. The last bar is printed with three quarters before “attacca subito Nr. 12” and is set as 3/4. Playback tempo ♩ = 97, a speaking pace for secco recitative, from Rattle (2:10) and Klemperer (2:21); Mozart gives no tempo.

licences.source: Written for this app (from the app's reviewed Così libretto drafts)
